name: Capelli Sport
verdict: Owned by GMA Accessories Inc., the private New York apparel company of founder and owner-CEO George Altirs. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: New York sportswear brand launched in 2011 by George Altirs; sits under GMA Accessories, Inc., a privately held New York apparel company Altirs founded in 1990. No state body or fund found anywhere in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Capelli Sport or GMA Accessories found (searched 30 Sep 2026).
